sentences.en: In Russian, nouns of foreign origin generally don't succumb to integration.
sentences.zh: 外来词在俄语中通常不会被同化。

sentences.en: Our integration with Europe has failed.
sentences.zh: 我们与欧洲的融合失败了。

sentences.en: We cannot unwind integration any more than we can stuff technology back into a box.
sentences.zh: 我们无法逆转一体化进程，就像无法将技术重新装回盒子里一样。

senses.zh: 结合；整合；一体化 - (不同肤色、种族、宗教信仰等的人的)混合，融合
